Mediabunny AAC encoder 1.62.1, MPL-2.0. The local ES module differs from the official npm bundle only in the two imports of its peer dependency (resolved to the adjacent Mediabunny browser bundle).
Source and WASM build instructions: https://github.com/Vanilagy/mediabunny/tree/v1.62.1/packages/aac-encoder
Package: https://registry.npmjs.org/@mediabunny/aac-encoder/-/aac-encoder-1.62.1.tgz
The AAC encoder contains FFmpeg's libavcodec and libavutil, under the GNU Lesser General Public License v2.1 or later. FFmpeg source: https://github.com/FFmpeg/FFmpeg
